mainEntity.name: What can go wrong when widening a doorway?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest risks are underestimating the structure, choosing the wrong swing direction, or creating a doorway that still leaves too little clearance after trim and hardware are installed. In Denver, changing a doorway opening can also trigger permit and inspection requirements, so skipping that step can create delays or rework.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common problems include hidden structural issues, inadequate final clearance, and missing permit steps. A proper site evaluation helps avoid a doorway that looks wider but still does not work for accessibility.
